title: Reproducing Kar, Shanker and Chari 1985: interface states against oxide thickness in unannealed ultrathin oxides

sample.paper: “n- and p-type epitaxial silicon (Monsanto Company) with (100) surface orientation and 1.0 Ω cm layer resistivity”
1.0 Ω cm epitaxial layer, n or p; dopant and layer thickness not stated
sample.ours: DOPING: n_type_1ohmcm_epi | p_type_1ohmcm_epi (recorded; no program reads it)

sample.paper: degrease, ultrasonic, acids; 30 min dry O2 at 1100 °C, stripped in HF
sample.ours: CLEAN: not_stated (the vocabulary has no solvent-acid-preoxide clean); three EVENTs
sample.note: The preoxide's heat is not simulated: written as a RUN, it would be read as the oxidation by the trap program and never removed.

sample.paper: “The oxide thickness varied between 79 and 227 Å”; set 2: 93, 125, 148, 164, 190, 208 Å (Figure 1 legend); others read from Figure 2
sample.ours: OXIDE_NM_MEASURED on the sample (recorded); the oxidation time is set to reproduce it
sample.note: Measurement method of thickness not stated.

sample.paper: about 100 Å semitransparent Au (n-Si) or Al (p-Si) dots, 0.5 mm, evaporated from W at 1×10⁻⁶ Torr; back contact the other metal

history.paper: “After degreasing in hot solvents, ultrasonic cleaning, and etching in acids,”
history.ours: EVENT Clean; CLEAN: not_stated on the sample (no vocabulary word for this clean)
history.note: Acids, times and temperatures not stated.

history.item: Sacrificial oxidation, dry O2, 1100 °C, 30 min (not simulated)
history.paper: “preoxidation was carried out in dry O2 at 1100 °C at 1 atm in a Thermco resistance-heated furnace for 30 min.”
history.note: Written as an event because the trap-density program takes the oxidation temperature and time from the first dry-oxygen RUN, and the language cannot remove the oxide in the strip that follows. Its 30 min at 1100 °C are left out of the simulated heat (variant below puts it back as a RUN).

history.item: Preoxide etched in HF, ultrasonic clean, DI rinse, N2 dry
history.paper: “Subsequently, the wafers were etched in HF, ultrasonically cleaned, rinsed in 14 M Ω cm de-ionized water, and dried in filtered N2 gas. Preoxidation was a part of the surface cleaning.”
history.ours: EVENT Strip KIND etch; no statement removes oxide

history.item: Final oxidation, dry O2, 900 °C, to 9.3 nm
history.paper: “Final oxidation was carried out in dry O2 at 900 °C at 1 atm. The oxide thickness varied between 79 and 227 Å.”; “fabricated under identical conditions except that the oxidation time was varied”
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 1180 TEMP 900->900 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: Temperature, gas and pressure are the paper's. The time is ours: 1180 s is what the thin-oxide program needs for 93 Å. Load temperature and push not stated.

history.ours: RUN Pull DURATION 60 TEMP 900->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: No pull, cooling gas or rate is given, and no post-oxidation anneal (stated). One minute in oxygen down to 400 °C is ours.

history.item: Front Au dots, about 100 Å, 0.5 mm, W filament, 1×10⁻⁶ Torr
history.paper: “introduced into a Varian VT-112A ultrahigh vacuum system for evaporation of the front semitransparent metal contact from a tungsten filament. Chamber pressure was held at about 1.0×10^-6 Torr”
history.note: Substrate temperature during evaporation not stated.

history.item: Back oxide removed in HF, Al back contact
history.paper: “Before the metal back contacts were evaporated, the oxide layer was removed from the back surface with the help of HF. For n-Si substrates, the front metal was Au and the back contact metal was Al; for p-type substrates, it was the reverse.”
“No post-oxidation or post-metallization annealing was carried out in this phase of the study, in order to preserve all the features in the interface state density profile”

history.item: Admittance, 30 Hz to 100 kHz, dark and illuminated
history.paper: “Admittance-voltage measurements were made in dark as well as under tungsten lamp illumination, over the frequency range of 30 Hz-100 kHz”
history.note: Quasi-Fermi level separation about 0.15 eV under illumination (PDF p. 2).

history.paper: “The second set of samples was made a period of time after the first set in order to check the reproducibility of results.”
history.ours: separate cases with the same history
history.note: The interval and any difference between the runs are not stated.

cases.label: n-Si/SiO2/Au, second set, 93 Å
cases.note: Thickness is printed in the Figure 1 legend; the oxidation time is chosen to give it, so thickness is not compared.

steps.paper: “introduced into a Varian VT-112A ultrahigh vacuum system for evaporation of the front semitransparent metal contact from a tungsten filament. Chamber pressure was held at about 1.0×10^-6 Torr”

steps.name: BackStrip
steps.label: Back oxide removed in HF, Al back contact
steps.paper: “Before the metal back contacts were evaporated, the oxide layer was removed from the back surface with the help of HF. For n-Si substrates, the front metal was Au and the back contact metal was Al; for p-type substrates, it was the reverse.”

steps.name: NoAnneal
steps.label: No post-oxidation or post-metallization anneal
steps.paper: “No post-oxidation or post-metallization annealing was carried out in this phase of the study, in order to preserve all the features in the interface state density profile”
steps.timing: none

steps.name: Measure
steps.label: Admittance, 30 Hz to 100 kHz, dark and illuminated
steps.paper: “Admittance-voltage measurements were made in dark as well as under tungsten lamp illumination, over the frequency range of 30 Hz-100 kHz”

steps.name: Clean
steps.label: Degrease, ultrasonic clean, acid etch
steps.paper: “After degreasing in hot solvents, ultrasonic cleaning, and etching in acids,”
steps.timing: not stated

steps.name: Preoxidation
steps.label: Sacrificial oxidation, dry O2, 1100 °C, 30 min (not simulated)
steps.paper: “preoxidation was carried out in dry O2 at 1100 °C at 1 atm in a Thermco resistance-heated furnace for 30 min.”

steps.name: Strip
steps.label: Preoxide etched in HF, ultrasonic clean, DI rinse, N2 dry
steps.paper: “Subsequently, the wafers were etched in HF, ultrasonically cleaned, rinsed in 14 M Ω cm de-ionized water, and dried in filtered N2 gas. Preoxidation was a part of the surface cleaning.”
steps.timing: not stated; time to loading not stated

steps.isl: RUN Pull DURATION 60 TEMP 900->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
steps.paper: not stated
steps.timing: not stated; 6 s to 10 min and an end of 200 to 800 °C searched
